About Myself:

I am a Branch Manager with almost 4 years of mortgage experience and have ranked in the top 250 loan officers in the United States. At my peak, I was able to help 46 homeowners in one month. I got into mortgage after spending years in the hospitality industry and believe that the only way I have been able to find success is by bringing integrity, trustworthiness, and respect to mortgage financing (referrals are what got me there!)

Upon entering the industry, I quickly moved up to become a sales manager and managed a team of 16+ loan officers for some time. From there, I moved away from pricey retail lenders who charge absurd origination fees and treat you like you are just a number. I have subsequently become a Branch Manager for the highest rated company I could find and am here to assist in finding the loan you need.
